Container.Name: audiobookshelf
Container.Overview: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server and web app. Supports multi-user w/ permissions and keeps progress in sync across devices. Free & open source mobile apps. Consider contributing by posting feedback, suggestions, feature requests on github or the forums.[br][br]Supports local network discovery (mDNS/Bonjour, http://audiobook.local) with Network Type Custom: br0 or Host, not Bridge. See the Port setting, and Disable mDNS and mDNS Name under Show more settings.
Container.Description: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server and web app. Supports multi-user w/ permissions and keeps progress in sync across devices. Free & open source mobile apps. Consider contributing by posting feedback, suggestions, feature requests on github or the forums.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port the server listens on inside the container. Keep 80 with Network Type Bridge (change Web UI Port instead). With Custom: br0 the server is reachable at its own IP on this port (set 13378 to keep the old port). With Host set a free port such as 13378, as port 80 is the UnRAID web UI; the WebUI link then still points to port 80, open http://[unraid-ip]:[port] manually. Switching an existing install from Bridge to br0 or Host changes its address (IP and/or port), which breaks URLs saved in apps and reverse proxy upstreams. With br0 the UnRAID host and bridge containers (e.g. SWAG, NPM) cannot reach the server unless Host access to custom networks is enabled in Docker settings.

Config.Name: Disable mDNS
Config.Description: Set to 1 or true to turn off local network discovery (mDNS/Bonjour). Leave empty to manage it in the web UI (Settings, Network Discovery). Discovery only works with Network Type Custom: br0 or Host.

Config.Name: mDNS Name
Config.Description: Name advertised on the local network, e.g. Audiobook is reachable at audiobook.local. Setting it locks the name in the web UI. Leave empty to set it in the web UI (Settings, Network Discovery).
